control.title: Video Poker: Jacks or Better
control.shortDescription: Offline video poker: Jacks or Better, Deuces Wild, multi-hand. No wifi needed

experiments.hypothesis: A gameplay-first hero communicates the product faster than text-first promotion.
Showing the core hand, variants, and multi-hand play first improves install intent.
Variant-led copy attracts more qualified searchers than social-led copy.
